page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.medium is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs under the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the configuration does not feature any graphics processing units or specialized hardware accelerators, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high memory density relative to compute resources, the ecs.m2.medium provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel processing power. It is designed for applications such as medium-sized databases, caching layers, in-memory data processing, and enterprise applications requiring a larger memory footprint without the overhead of additional vCPUs.
